_extra.definitions: pelvisHeight + spine + chestLen + neck + headLen = height. spine = pelvis->spine joint, chestLen = spine->chest (shoulder line), neck = chest->head joint (skull base; on the drawing the neck base sits neckBaseFraction of the way up), headLen = head joint->crown. upperArm/forearm from the drawn throwing arm, hand = 2 x (wrist->drawn palm socket) so the palm centre is at half, thigh/shin = mean of both drawn legs, footLen = heel->toe, ankleHeight = ankle above the sole.
